basic_info.description: First time on the market in > 70 years. This stately Edwardian, built in 1904, sits proudly atop Willard with sweeping views that look out at nearby Cole Valley, beyond to the San Francisco skyline, and at night, a full moon rise over the East Bay hills. Lovingly held by one family for generations, the home is rich with history, architectural beauty, timeless charmand ready for its next chapter. Exquisite period details include rich wood paneling, coved ceilings, built-in cabinetry, and a period tiled fireplace. A grand foyer opens to a light-filled living room with a wood-burning fireplace. The formal dining room, with a decorative fireplace, built-ins, and stunning outlooks, flows into a spacious eat-in kitchen that opens onto an expansive sunny rear deck. Upstairs are three large bedrooms,  plus a smaller fourth bedroom ideal for an office or nursery, and two bathrooms. The lower level offers add'l rms with views, ideal for expansion. A closet plumbed for a toilet @ lwr level.   While largely original, the home includes a newer roof (2019) and upgraded electrical (2025), offering a solid foundation for future updates.
